ngd_tab Description: Ranks E-G, RPG stats, classes and the God Menu
ngd_divine_eye_description: Click a creature to open the God Menu
ngd_bless_star_description: Click a creature: +1 star. Ordinary people awaken as rank E. At 12 stars it breaks through
ngd_open_menu Description: Open the God Menu for the selected creature
ngd_toggle_auto Description: Toggle whether fighters try to break through on their own
ngd_btn_break_desc: Instantly break through to the next rank (star 1, +10 points)
ngd_btn_exp_desc: Guild rank EXP for one star
ngd_btn_allot_desc: Spend unspent points according to class
ngd_btn_immortal_desc: Immortal: takes no damage, never dies, never ages out
ngd_starfall_blade_description: A sword forged from a dying star. Cleaves three foes at once
ngd_chrono_blade_description: Its guard holds a clock that never ticks. Blindingly fast strikes
ngd_thunder_spear_description: Lightning coils around its head and hurls foes back
ngd_rift_scythe_description: Each swing tears a crack in space itself
ngd_cosmos_hammer_description: A galaxy sleeps inside its head. Shatters armies
ngd_crescent_bow_description: A bow of moonlight. Its arrows never miss their mark
ngd_gift_relic_description: Click a creature: grants a random divine relic weapon and a power boost
ngd_starfall_description: Calls down a storm of falling stars over a wide area
ngd_time_stop_description: Law of Time: freezes every creature nearby for 12 seconds
ngd_mass_ascension_description: Everyone nearby awakens, gains +1 star and is fully healed
ngd_news_register: {0} registered at the {1} Guild and was assessed as rank {2}!
ngd_news_quest: The {0} Guild cleared a rank {1} monster hunt! Party led by {2}
ngd_news_crisis: Financial crisis in {0}! The city defaulted on its bank loans
ngd_era_forward Description: Push the whole world into the next era
ngd_era_back Description: Send the world back to the previous era
ngd_open_rift_description: Tear open a dimensional rift: minions and a ranked boss pour out. Nearby guilds post a bounty
ngd_chronicle_btn Description: Read the chronicle of legends, rifts and great deeds
ngd_chron_empty: No legends have been written yet...
ngd_toggle_badges Description: Show or hide rank badges above heads (zoom in to see them)
ngd_news_rift: A dimensional rift tore open near {0}! A rank {1} boss emerges: {2}
ngd_chron_rift: A rift opened near {0}, unleashing a rank {1} boss
ngd_news_boss_slain: {0} slew the rift boss {1} and claimed a divine relic!
ngd_news_legend: A LEGEND IS BORN! {0} has ascended to rank {1}!
ngd_news_ritual: STARLESS NIGHT! The Cult of the Dying Star sacrificed themselves in {0} and tore open a rift!
ngd_news_guild_tier: The {0} Adventurers' Guild has risen to {1} rank!
